ORDER BY AUTH_CODE OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM T_AUTH WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AUTH_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTH (AUTH_CODE, AUTH_NAME, AUTH_DESC, AUTH_TYPE, FSTG_MENU_NO, USE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{authCode}, #{authName}, #{authDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fstgMenuNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{useYn},'Y'), SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_AUTH_MENU t USING DUAL ON (t.MENU_NO = #{menuNo} AND t.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET READ_YN = #{readYn}, WRITE_YN = #{writeYn}, USE_YN = 'Y', REG_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (AUTH_CODE, MENU_NO, USE_YN, READ_YN, WRITE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{authCode}, #{menuNo}, 'Y', #{readYn}, #{writeYn}, SYSDATE)
